\section[ōṇaṁ]{\ml{ഓണം} (ōṇaṁ) — Onam}

\label{lesson:ML-C141-onam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a class, then the Malayalam for an answer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ഓണം}}
\textbf{\ml{ഓണം}} (\emph{ōṇaṁ}) — Kerala's harvest festival, in \textbf{\ml{ചിങ്ങം}}, with a \textbf{\ml{സദ്യ}} and a flower \textbf{\ml{കോലം}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The biggest day of the year.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ōṇaṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ōṇaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{ōṇaṁ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a class, then the Malayalam for an answer, then say \emph{ōṇaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ഓണം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Onam\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[(dialogue)]{Home and the table — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R141-first-pass-home-food-table}



\begin{quote}
Name the great feast day, then the temple festival.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item name a house, a room, the kitchen, the bathroom and the yard
  \item ask where the key is; name a bed, an umbrella, glasses and a watch
  \item breakfast, lunch, dinner; a feast and the sweet that ends it
  \item fish, meat, an egg, vegetables, an onion
  \item dosa, sambar, appam, puttu, and fish curry
  \item a mango, a jackfruit, a lemon, ginger; ask if someone wants sugar
  \item ask for a glass of water and a cup of tea; name a bottle, a spoon and a plate
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
House? (\textbf{\ml{വീട്}}.) Room? (\textbf{\ml{മുറി}}.) Kitchen? (\textbf{\ml{അടുക്കള}}.) Bathroom? (\textbf{\ml{കുളിമുറി}}.) Yard? (\textbf{\ml{മുറ്റം}}.) Bed, key, umbrella, glasses, watch? (\textbf{\ml{കിടക്ക}, \ml{താക്കോൽ}, \ml{കുട}, \ml{കണ്ണട}, \ml{വാച്ച്}}.) Breakfast, lunch, dinner? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രാതൽ}, \ml{ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണം}, \ml{അത്താഴം}}.) Feast? (\textbf{\ml{സദ്യ}}.) Sweet? (\textbf{\ml{പായസം}}.) Fish, meat, egg? (\textbf{\ml{മീൻ}, \ml{ഇറച്ചി}, \ml{മുട്ട}}.) Vegetables? (\textbf{\ml{പച്ചക്കറി}}.) Onion? (\textbf{\ml{ഉള്ളി}}.) Dosa, sambar, appam, puttu, curry? (\textbf{\ml{ദോശ}, \ml{സാമ്പാർ}, \ml{അപ്പം}, \ml{പുട്ട്}, \ml{കറി}}.) Mango, jackfruit, lemon, ginger, sugar? (\textbf{\ml{മാങ്ങ}, \ml{ചക്ക}, \ml{നാരങ്ങ}, \ml{ഇഞ്ചി}, \ml{പഞ്ചസാര}}.) Glass, bottle, cup, spoon, plate? (\textbf{\ml{ഗ്ലാസ്}, \ml{കുപ്പി}, \ml{കപ്പ്}, \ml{സ്പൂൺ}, \ml{പ്ലേറ്റ്}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Out in Kerala — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R141-second-pass-town-travel-time}



\begin{quote}
Ask where the market is, then where the temple is.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item name a church or mosque, a bridge and a village
  \item the sea, the beach, a pond, a well, a harbour
  \item a vehicle, a car, a train, a plane, an autorickshaw
  \item a bird, a snake, a monkey, a tiger, a rabbit
  \item ask the time; one minute; an hour, a month, a year
  \item ask for a pen and some paper; name a pencil, a class and an answer
  \item Onam, Vishu, Christmas, Eid and a temple festival
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Market? (\textbf{\ml{ചന്ത}}.) Temple? (\textbf{\ml{ക്ഷേത്രം}}.) Church or mosque? (\textbf{\ml{പള്ളി}}.) Bridge? (\textbf{\ml{പാലം}}.) Village? (\textbf{\ml{ഗ്രാമം}}.) Sea, beach, pond, well, harbour? (\textbf{\ml{കടൽ}, \ml{കടപ്പുറം}, \ml{കുളം}, \ml{കിണർ}, \ml{തുറമുഖം}}.) Vehicle, car, train, plane, auto? (\textbf{\ml{വണ്ടി}, \ml{കാർ}, \ml{തീവണ്ടി}, \ml{വിമാനം}, \ml{ഓട്ടോ}}.) Bird, snake, monkey, tiger, rabbit? (\textbf{\ml{പക്ഷി}, \ml{പാമ്പ്}, \ml{കുരങ്ങ്}, \ml{കടുവ}, \ml{മുയൽ}}.) Time? (\textbf{\ml{സമയം}}.) Minute, hour, month, year? (\textbf{\ml{മിനിറ്റ്}, \ml{മണിക്കൂർ}, \ml{മാസം}, \ml{വർഷം}}.) Pen, pencil, paper, class, answer? (\textbf{\ml{പേന}, \ml{പെൻസിൽ}, \ml{കടലാസ്}, \ml{ക്ലാസ്}, \ml{ഉത്തരം}}.) Onam, Vishu, Christmas, Eid, festival? (\textbf{\ml{ഓണം}, \ml{വിഷു}, \ml{ക്രിസ്മസ്}, \ml{പെരുന്നാൾ}, \ml{ഉത്സവം}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
